summary: Calloway County, KY fire tower, 85 ft; a November 1960 shooting report names its operator. No build date, fate or current site status found.

events.note: Mrs. Ruth Fergerson was operating the tower at the time of the shooting reported in November 1960
Four youths were charged with firing eight rifle shots at the tower; six went through the glass windows. The four were arrested and held in the county jail

evidence.supports: The tower was 85 feet tall (25.9 m)
evidence.quote: Six shots from a .22 caliber automatic rifle slammed through the glass windows of the 85 feet tall tower

evidence.supports: An operator was working the tower at the time of the shooting
evidence.quote: Mrs. Ruth Fergerson, who was operating the tower at the time

evidence.supports: Four youths were held in the county jail on charges of firing eight shots at the tower, six miles east of the town
evidence.quote: Four Calloway County youths today are being held in Calloway County jail on charges of firing eight shots from a rifle into a fire tower six miles east of here Sunday afternoon.

evidence.supports: The operator dropped to the floor when the shooting started
evidence.quote: she dropped to the floor when the shooting started

evidence.supports: The four were arrested about half an hour later by the sheriff
evidence.quote: The quartet was arrested about a half-hour later by Sheriff Cohen Stubblefield.

evidence.supports: Two more shots hit the outside of the tower and glanced away
evidence.quote: and the other two hit the outside and glanced away.

evidence.supports: None of the boys reportedly made a statement
evidence.quote: None of the boys reportedly made a statement.

evidence.supports: The forest-lookout site files the clipping under Calloway County and Murray
The National Historic Lookout Register lists 17 Kentucky lookouts; this tower is not among them
evidence.quote: There are 17 lookouts registered in Kentucky.

sources.title: Calloway County
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (eastern US), quoting The Paducah Sun

notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this tower: a 1960 clipping on a hobby site, which gives the height, the operator and the shooting. No build date, fate or present status found. The clipping does not name Murray in its text; the place comes from the site's heading and the 'six miles east of here' dateline. Location and coordinates in the record were not checked against any other source. The story is about 169 words.
